advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Associate Maintenance Technician
locations: United States- North Kansas City, Missouri
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs entry level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but not limited to: adjusting functional parts of devices and control instruments to sustain and improve operations; repairing or replacing defective parts; repairing machine tools. · Provides support and back up for other members of department as needed by leadership. · Assures compliance with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Completes on the job training for career development. · Updates records in CMMS. · Provides inputs in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Must be able to use basic hand tools. · Knowledge of basic electrical, mechanical and fluid power systems. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. Pay Range $21.42 — $27.38 USD ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to all applicants and employees without regard to age, color, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other legally protected status. angellist-angellist:lever:29385730-46e1-.title: Product Designer, Nova
angellist-angellist:lever:29385730-46e1-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role Every year, trillions of dollars move from investors to funds and funds to companies in private markets. And every single time this money moves, everyone holds their breath a little bit. Did I really send these millions of dollars to the right bank account? Will my investor capital arrive on time for my deployment? Nova is the payment network that solves this. Within AngelList, we’ve been running it internally for the past five years, moving $90B between funds and investors without the risk of sending money to the wrong place. We’re now extending this network outside AngelList: to the rest of the venture, private equity, and real estate. You will own the design vision for the Nova business and execution across the team for all products within this strategy.
responsibilities: Design thoughtful product experiences on both sides of the payments network, creating connected experiences for funds, investors, and the teams that support them.
Drive scoping for the most ambiguous areas of the product vision, including how these products will interact with other ones (both within AngelList and beyond).
Set the standard for visual and interaction patterns within this business area that other designers on the team will calibrate to.
Talk regularly with customers, using research and leverage insights to lead cross-functional teams in driving thoughtful, high-ROI solutions

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5c73c691-b659-.title: Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5c73c691-b659-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts based in the United States. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on accelerating digital product management maturity across complex, high-priority products and teams. You will embed directly with product organizations to strengthen product practices and adoption of an outcome-oriented operating model. The role combines hands-on product leadership, coaching, strategic problem solving, and cross-functional influence. You will help teams define meaningful problems, establish measurable outcomes, improve roadmaps, and make informed investment and prioritization decisions. Working across business, technology, data, compliance, quality, and product leadership, you will help resolve dependencies and navigate complex environments. You will also capture lessons from engagements and translate them into reusable playbooks, standards, tools, and practices that improve enterprise-wide product capabilities. This is an opportunity to shape how digital products are managed while helping teams deliver measurable value in a highly collaborative, science-driven environment. Embedded product leadership: Embed with complex and strategically important products and teams to strengthen product management practices, accelerate adoption of the digital product operating model, and improve product maturity. Product coaching and capability building: Act as a senior hands-on player-coach for Digital Product Managers and cross-functional teams, developing capabilities in problem framing, discovery, product strategy, roadmapping, OKRs, KPIs, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and value measurement. Direct product management: When a dedicated product manager is not available, temporarily assume product management responsibilities, including shaping product direction, defining outcomes, aligning stakeholders, resolving trade-offs, and supporting roadmap and capacity decisions. Outcome-oriented product strategy: Help teams connect business and enterprise strategy to product outcomes, develop product visions and strategies, improve roadmaps, establish measurable success criteria, and make investment recommendations. Discovery and prioritization: Guide teams in using customer insights, product data, experimentation, business context, feasibility, risk, capacity, and dependencies to make evidence-based product decisions. Cross-functional leadership: Partner with business, technology, engineering, data, design, compliance, quality, operations, and adjacent product teams to clarify roles, decision rights, operating rhythms, dependencies, and expectations. Stakeholder influence: Influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority, communicate product direction and trade-offs clearly, and escalate significant blockers or alignment issues when necessary. Catalyst engagement execution: Lead engagement activities from initial product and team assessment through planning, embedded coaching, adoption measurement, transition, and lessons learned. Continuous improvement: Identify capability gaps, adoption barriers, and recurring product-management challenges, then translate practical learnings into reusable examples, templates, playbooks, standards, and operating practices. Performance measurement: Define and track engagement success measures such as product management capability growth, team adoption, product maturity, measurable product outcomes, and sustained adoption after the engagement concludes. Requirements: Education and experience: Bachelor's degree plus at least 7 years of relevant experience, Master's degree plus 5 years, Doctorate plus 3 years, Associate's degree plus 12 years, or high school diploma/GED plus 14 years in digital product management, product leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or a related

redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:8.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Sanabil Venture Studio by Redesign Health (SSRH) empowers founders to launch and scale transformative healthcare companies in the Kingdom. Saudi Arabia represents one of the world's most promising opportunities for healthcare innovation. We support founders in launching world-class companies that benefit from Saudi Arabia's robust infrastructure, forward-thinking approach to innovation, and accelerating pace of progress. Sanabil Venture Studio by Redesign Health is dedicated to launching AI-native healthcare ventures that transform how care is delivered and experienced. Like the startups we build, we embed AI deeply into all our operations, empowering our team to focus their creativity and expertise on the most complex challenges and high-impact opportunities. We're seeking curious, adaptable individuals who are excited to explore new ways of working, eager to constantly experiment, and committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible at the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence. ABOUT THE JOB As Platform Lead, you will play a central role in identifying exceptional founders and sourcing deals for SSRH to invest in. This strategic, hands-on position directly impacts patient outcomes, as well as the growth and success of SSRH, its founders and its community. Your responsibilities will span these key areas: 1. Attract, Engage with, and Assess High-Quality Founders: Identify top-tier founding entrepreneurs for SSRH to invest in, with such founders running independent portfolio companies following SSRH’s investment. 2. Building a robust brand through marketing and communications activities that reliably produce traction and founders. 3. Manage the founder platform and experience for SSRH founders following SSRH’s investment, coordinating the strategic support services SSRH provides to its portfolio companies. Redesign health is an AI native company, we expect you to leverage AI skills to support you with the above responsibilities. As an early member of SSRH, you will also contribute to building the operations and culture of our Saudi innovation platform. You’ll collaborate with U.S.-based counterparts, leverage Redesign’s existing infrastructure, and adapt strategies to the Saudi market. This role reports to the Senior Director of New Ventures in Riyadh. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - SSRH is recognized nationally as the leading healthcare venture-building platform. - Two or more high-impact strategic partnerships established with Saudi government, enterprise, venture hubs/incubator entities in the 6 months. - A thriving founder community actively engaged through events, mentorship, and digital channels. - Increased visibility and positive sentiment around Redesign Health’s mission in the Kingdom (measured via engagement and PR reach). - A self-sufficient, high-performing Saudi Platform team that attracts the best founders and the best companies that serves as a model for future international funds WHAT YOU’LL DO Attract, Engage With, and Assess High-Quality Founders - Design and implement a comprehensive founder strategy to engage with brilliant potential healthcare founders for SSRH to invest in. - Attract, engage with, and assess top founders by building a robust funnel of top tier founders to enter into due diligence with, via various mechanisms including brand and ecosystem development, active outbound, partnerships and events. - Conduct due diligence with the investment team to assess the founder and concept and prepare them for the Investment Committee. - Build and maintain a positive, professional founder journey selling founders on the value of Redesign. - Build and maintain relationships with government entities (e.g., Monsha’at, Ministry of Health, Vision 2030 programs), universities, accelerators, and corporate partners. - Organize strategic events such as Founder Salons, investor roundtables, and ecosystem workshops. - Identify collaboration opportunities for Redesign portfoli
